Bundled receipt text PDF reader

smalot/pdfparser v2.13.1
Source: https://github.com/smalot/pdfparser
License: LGPL-3.0; source and original license supplied in vendor/smalot/pdfparser.

symfony/polyfill-mbstring
Version and upstream commit are recorded in composer.lock.
Source: https://github.com/symfony/polyfill-mbstring
License: MIT; source and original license supplied in vendor/symfony/polyfill-mbstring.

Installed without development packages, plugins or install scripts.
The live application needs no Composer command, external PDF executable,
shell permission or network connection to extract searchable PDF text.
Image-only PDFs still require OCR or a text-searchable original export.
